reason: I'd probably poke at the free tier on one client site, but for the handful of before/after shots I send clients, my free extension plus a Figma frame already does the job. I'm not adding another subscription until a project actually forces it.
objection: No reviews and a brand-new tool, so I don't know if the screenshots come out clean enough to put in front of a client. Lazy-loaded images, cookie banners and sticky headers breaking full-page shots would make me look bad, not professional.
would_change_my_mind: A free run on one of my real client sites where all four device sizes come out clean and the share link or change report looks polished enough to send a client as is.
